name: Cybersecurity Assessment & Scanner Tooling

smoke_tests.template:
from src.utils.net_util import is_private_ip

def test_private_ip():
    assert is_private_ip('192.168.1.1') is True
    assert is_private_ip('8.8.8.8') is False

ci_workflow:
name: {project_name} CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v10
      - run: uv run pytest tests
